status: specification; not authorised for execution. Corrected copy (review_closure/causal-target-spec-v1-r1, 2026-10-05); original preserved

passive_labelled_trajectory.default_output: version space within declared class; AMBIGUOUS unless singleton
passive_labelled_trajectory.refutation: a repeated state with two successors

value_labels.CLASS_ENTAILED: unvisited state where every version-space member in the declared class agrees; conditional on the class and the six assumptions; never reported as observed
value_labels.UNDETERMINED: version-space members disagree; no value claimed

never_claimed: values on unvisited states that are not class-entailed
identification without class and coverage argument

chosen_state_successor_queries.query: external reset of the whole state to x, apply unchanged F once, return all n bits
chosen_state_successor_queries.evidence_type: simulator oracle, not passive real-world evidence

primary_future_target.statement: exact functional recovery of F in C(n,k) under chosen state-successor queries
primary_future_target.function_family: all Boolean functions on the support
primary_future_target.identifiability_scope: relative to C(n,k); class membership not certifiable with <2^n queries when n>2k

prior_art.source: Bshouty and Costa, arXiv:1706.06934v1, Section 3.2 Theorem 2
prior_art.consequence: deterministic non-adaptive exact learner for the per-coordinate class d-Junta with d=k; one shared query set identifies the product class C(n,k) under R4
prior_art.decision: NO_JUSTIFIED_IMPLEMENTATION for the withdrawn draft query study

recovered_object.equivalence: functional equality on all 2^n states; no node relabelling
recovered_object.canonical_name: representation choice, never reported as original gate

invalid_semantics.deterministic_oracle_not_verified_in_cla: correct outcome: falsifies membership in C(n,k)
invalid_semantics.note: membership can be falsified by an inconsistent transcript but never certified with fewer than 2^n queries when n>2k

endpoint_implications.exact_functional_equivalence=>interventi: true for reset_then_step and mechanism_replacement (deterministic, full state)

mdl_role: selection only; identification requires a singleton consistent set

witness_support.W2: syntax and declared edges not identifiable from R3
witness_support.W4: autonomous consistency does not give intervention consistency

corrections.C-R2: not applicable to this file (no sampler named here)
